blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Prosecutors may drop the bribery charge in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial if they cannot present evidence before the Senate turns to the 2027 national budget, prosecution spokesperson Benjamin Tolosa Jr. said Sunday. He said prosecutors aim to finish presenting evidence against Duterte by mid-October, when the Senate is expected to prioritize discussions on the proposed P7.2-trillion spending plan for next year. “Our goal is to wrap up our presentation of evidence before the break. So if there isn’t much time left … that could be a major factor for us not to present evidence with respect […]...
